prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A man seen from behind, his face not visible, leans his shoulder against the shut wooden door in the side of the ark, both palms flat on the wet boards. Dusk, rain streaming down the black pitch. Helpless and cold. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
